The Demon of Many Colors

Original: https://shrouded-lands.fandom.com/wiki/The_Demon_of_Many_Colors

  • *Inspiration:** ‘Rainbow Demon’ by Uriah Heep

All along the World’s Edge, from misty morning and on through night and day, rides a demon on his horse of crimson fire. His body is difficult to make out, all twisted angles and a shifting miasma of colors and behind him stretches a great shadow that is so dark that it blinds those who fall under it.

He rides along the entire Edge every day on a perfectly predictable schedule, cutting down any who stand in his way with his prism sword, but does not harass anyone who stays well clear of him.

Hooks:

  • Why is the demon doing this?
  • Where does the demon come from? Why does he look like that?
